batches_dates_chk.name: batches_dates_chk
batches_dates_chk.value: "batches"."expiry_date" is null or "batches"."mfg_date" is null or "batches"."expiry_date" >= "batches"."mfg_date"

products_sku_uq.name: products_sku_uq
products_sku_uq.where: "products"."deleted_at" is null and "products"."sku" is not null

dispatch_orders_document_chk.name: dispatch_orders_document_chk
dispatch_orders_document_chk.value: "dispatch_orders"."sales_order_id" is not null or "dispatch_orders"."invoice_id" is not null

credit_debit_notes_party_chk.name: credit_debit_notes_party_chk
credit_debit_notes_party_chk.value:
("credit_debit_notes"."party_type" = 'customer' and "credit_debit_notes"."customer_id" is not null and "credit_debit_notes"."supplier_id" is null)
       or ("credit_debit_notes"."party_type" = 'supplier' and "credit_debit_notes"."supplier_id" is not null and "credit_debit_notes"."customer_id" is null)

party_ledger_party_chk.name: party_ledger_party_chk
party_ledger_party_chk.value:
("party_ledger_entries"."party_type" = 'customer' and "party_ledger_entries"."customer_id" is not null and "party_ledger_entries"."supplier_id" is null)
       or ("party_ledger_entries"."party_type" = 'supplier' and "party_ledger_entries"."supplier_id" is not null and "party_ledger_entries"."customer_id" is null)

payments_party_chk.name: payments_party_chk
payments_party_chk.value:
("payments"."party_type" = 'customer' and "payments"."customer_id" is not null)
       or ("payments"."party_type" = 'supplier' and "payments"."supplier_id" is not null)
       or ("payments"."party_type" = 'employee' and "payments"."employee_id" is not null)
       or ("payments"."party_type" = 'other')
